name: credential-choice-required-409
description: When more than one credential resolves for a principal and target, the broker does not pick one silently: POST /sessions answers 409 credential_choice_required. At this tag one credential resolves (E0 has one key), so the code is published now and no provider owes it yet; the field that carries the operator's choice arrives with the vault tag. A consumer that does not know a code handles the response by its HTTP status.

error.message: more than one credential resolves; choose one
not a code in this tag
